fields.System.Title: INT-105 — Deduplicate on external reference
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want repeated ERP messages recognised as repeats, so that a network
retry does not become a second order and a second shipment.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an inbound message, then (source_system, external_reference, message_type) is
  • stored with a unique database constraint.
  • - Given a message whose reference already exists, then it is treated as already
  • processed and the original outcome returned.
  • - Given two identical messages arriving concurrently, then exactly one is processed.
  • - Given a genuinely different message reusing a reference, then it is flagged as a
  • conflict for a human rather than silently overwriting.
  • - Given the dedupe records, then they are retained long enough to cover realistic retry
  • windows.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | inbound message log |
| Risks | Duplicate order and double shipment ([doc 09 §3.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency (sequential and concurrent) |
